verses.text: I will praise thee, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

segments.text: I will praise
thee
, O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

verses.text: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

segments.text: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

verses.text: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

segments.text: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

verses.text: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.

segments.text: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.

notes: 9.4 judging right: Heb. judging in righteousness

verses.text: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

segments.text: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

verses.text: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

segments.text: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

notes: 9.6 O thou…: or, The destructions of the enemy are come to a perpetual end: and their cities hast thou destroyed, etc

verses.text: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

segments.text: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

verses.text: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

segments.text: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

verses.text: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

segments.text: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

notes: 9.9 a refuge: Heb. an high place

verses.text: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

segments.text: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

verses.text: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

segments.text: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

verses.text: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.

segments.text: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.

verses.text: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

segments.text: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble
which I suffer
of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:

verses.text: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

segments.text: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

verses.text: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

segments.text: The heathen are sunk down in the pit
that
they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

verses.text: The LORD is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

segments.text: The LORD is known
by
the judgment
which
he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

verses.text: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.

segments.text: The wicked shall be turned into hell,
and
all the nations that forget God.

verses.text: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.

segments.text: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall
not
perish for ever.

verses.text: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

segments.text: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

verses.text: Put them in fear, O LORD: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

segments.text: Put them in fear, O LORD:
that
the nations may know themselves
to be but
men. Selah.

headings.text: To the chief Musician upon Muthlabben, A Psalm of David.
